methodology: Per-class dHash near-duplicate connected-components (Hamming <= 2), groups assigned to train/validation/test via a seeded greedy per-class-balanced assignment targeting 70/15/15, PLUS the same independent leak-repair safety-net check as Dataset 1 (0 image(s) demoted). File-modification timestamps were checked and found unreliable (inconsistent with filename order, irregular gaps - likely a RAR-extraction artifact) and were NOT used for grouping.
